chunks: If their aversion still weighs upon you, seek out a tunnel (going deep) into the earth, or a ladder reaching out to the skies, and bring them a sign: (Even then they will not believe). If God had willed He would have brought them all to the right path. So be not like the pagans.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of digging a tunnel into the earth or climbing a ladder to the sky in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Prophet's human emotional struggle with the stubbornness of the Quraysh, validating his empathy while reminding him that ultimate guidance rests with Allah. The metaphor of 'digging a tunnel' or 'climbing a ladder' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as illustrating the futility of forcing belief through miraculous signs if the hearts are sealed by divine decree. It serves as a practical lesson for believers to remain steadfast in conveying the message without being consumed by the rejection of the heedless.
